title: MV Plug in to have Dynamic Borders ( MV )

posts.body:
So, a lot of rpg maker games when ported to console get custom borders for fullscreen mode, that change depending on the area, any idea on how to possibly do that on rpgmaker MV?
thanks in advance

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
I can build a frame outside the game, but I stop building it as I got trouble
moving the frame, but for 1 image, you can place it outside without issues.
as long the screen is in the center, you can disable full screenMode if you
only want a canvas around it like "full screen".
another way is to make map a bit bigger and use "show picture" that stays,
if you have the marges left use (like 144px each side (3 tiles), this may work too.
you can show it if you go full screen (evented way).
